system_level_findings.root_cause: Revolver evidence was embedded in broader debt and covenant analysis instead of being evaluated as a separate note module.
system_level_findings.shared_fix: Added a generic revolver module covering facility disclosure, commitment or capacity, borrowing or availability, maturity, restrictions, and the rule that availability is not covenant headroom.

system_level_findings.root_cause: Acquisition cash-flow facts and transaction disclosures were not joined into a dedicated period-aware note module.
system_level_findings.shared_fix: Added a generic acquisition module that requires a selected-filing scan, period-matched amount evidence, transaction terms, accounting disclosure, and a separate bridge for post-period events.

system_level_findings.root_cause: A secondary structured acquisition fact could be surfaced without preserving a complete period lineage, creating a risk of duplicate or non-comparable amounts.
system_level_findings.shared_fix: Bound acquisition amount evidence to the selected filing accession and selected period; unselected structured facts may be retained only as non-numeric disclosure signals.

system_level_findings.root_cause: A non-numeric acquisition tag signal inherited an XBRL-like source tag and was therefore interpreted by the unit/currency validator as a monetary fact.
system_level_findings.shared_fix: Classified unselected structured-fact signals as text evidence with a distinct source-tag namespace; the monetary validator now continues to protect actual numeric facts without misclassifying text signals.

preserved_runs.review_finding: Acquisition secondary-fact period lineage remained incomplete.
P0 unit/currency control correctly blocked a mis-typed non-numeric structured-fact signal.
